what_it_is.prose: Embrace is an in-orbit technology-demonstration payload from Cosmoserve Space, an early-stage Indian startup, flown on Skyroot's Vikram-1 'Aagaman' maiden orbital mission of 18 July 2026. 'Mission Embrace' aims to demonstrate a soft-robotic capture mechanism in orbit — pitched in press coverage as a world-first attempt at soft-robotic in-orbit capture, relevant to future debris-removal and satellite-servicing concepts. Public evidence is limited to the Vikram-1 payload announcements and a handful of press items around the launch, so this remains an honest compact stub pending a primary technical description and on-orbit results.
